content.text: Destinations Czech Republic At Abbey Travel we offer package holidays to the Czech Republic with flights, accommodation, transfers and expert advice. Book your Czech Republic holiday online today! Discover the Czech Republic The Czech Republic, located in the heart of central Europe, is a country rich in history, culture and natural beauty. It enjoys a temperate climate, with Summers reaching 27°C and Winters averaging -5°C to 0°C, while Spring and Autumn bring mild temperatures with occasional rainfall. A mixture of bustling cities, rolling plains, low mountains and extensive forested areas mean the Czech Republic has a varied landscape waiting to be explored. The Czech Republic is a land steeped in history and offers a wide array of attractions. Visitors can explore historic cities like Prague, Brno, and Český Krumlov, each boasting stunning architecture, charming old towns, and vibrant cultural scenes. In Prague, the capital city, you can marvel at the iconic Charles Bridge, the majestic Prague Castle, and the historic Old Town Square with its Astronomical Clock. Cities in the Czech Republic are truly magical, offering plenty to see and do. The Czech Republic caters to all types of holiday goers. Whether you're seeking a romantic couples holiday to the Czech Republic, a fun-filled family adventure, an exciting holiday with friends, or a solo exploration, the Czech Republic has something for everyone. Its rich history, vibrant culture, and diverse attractions make it a perfect destination for an unforgettable holiday. There are a number of flights to the Czech Republic every week, with the flight taking about 2 hours and 30 minutes non-stop.
